name: python-huffman-coding
title: Canonical Huffman Coding
blurb: Canonical Huffman over lowercase text: decode(encode(text)) answers with the letters encode was sent on shipped and seeded corpora, no shipped code opens where another closes, and a skewed text pays strictly under eight bits a letter.
default_description: A deterministic ladder whose wordlist reads back the letters it was sent on any text, and whose codes never open where another code closes.
